# video-shotcraft (third-party material)

Source: https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft, commit 43bd349a136651865ecfa6ea1cf012f6e957d304 (2026-10-18), taken 2026-10-23.
Licence: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE next to this file). Copyright the video-shotcraft authors.

What is copied here, unmodified, as reference and as source for ports:
- `references/`  the shot recipe cards (124 cards, 150 shots; written in Chinese), aesthetic rules, sound-design and beat-sync method, sequences, final-review checklist, JianYing and publishing guides
- `demos/`       the Remotion (React) reference implementation of each card
- `lib/`         reusable Remotion components (page camera, captions, flash cut, digit roll ...)
- `audio/`       149 sound effects in 16 categories and 5 music tracks; per-file sources and licences are in `audio/ATTRIBUTION.md` (Mixkit licences; a few files have no recorded source there)
- `jianying-export/`, `publish/`  the JianYing (CapCut CN) draft installer and the Upload-Post publisher
- `gallery/`, `SKILL.md`  the static gallery page and the agent skill text

Changes: none to these files. Anything derived from them (ports to this project's own renderer, catalogue entries, tests) lives in `renderer/runtime/`, `vt/` and `tests/` and says so in its header. `index.json` is generated by `scripts/build_shotcraft_index.py`.
Remotion itself is not used by this product; the recipes are re-implemented in HyperFrames/GSAP (plan.md, Phase 12).
